name: 缇里安
src: 月银纪史诗/第九歌_落日之弓.md:173
who: Tirian, an elf warden of the old forest's Watcher clan who looks twenty-five, three years into holding the white stone line: about 180 cm, slender and tall, the shoulders and back built by centuries of drawing a bow, the right arm a size thicker than the left, a thick callus across the knuckles of the right hand. Long pale gold, nearly white hair tied back with a vine cord, long pointed elf ears slightly reddened by forest wind. Deep canopy-green eyes that do not blink and wait for the other person to move first. A clean, cold, narrow face that no one has seen smile in three years. A still, waiting air. Both arms are whole and strong in this version, the right arm NOT hanging. He carries exactly ONE arrow and never a second: in every panel there is only a single arrow anywhere in the picture, never one nocked on the bow and another in the quiver at the same time.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm young-looking elf's face, deep forest-green eyes, long pointed ears, pale gold near-white hair, a still, closed mouth; he looks twenty-five and has not smiled.
build: 180 cm, slender and tall, a straight back, the right arm and shoulder visibly thicker than the left.
palette: pale gold and dead-leaf brown, forest green, bow-wood brown, a little silver-white
casual: His warden's clothes for this season: a hooded tunic and long cloak in the brown of dead leaves, dark fitted leggings and soft boots, a leather bracer on the left forearm, a vine cord belt. A long bow carved from a naturally fallen tree of his own forest slung across his back, a quiver at the hip on the right hand side holding exactly one arrow. A still, watchful look.
private: Off watch: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved pale linen tunic with the collar open, soft leggings, the hair untied and falling over the shoulders. He holds a small cup in the right hand, a still, faraway look, the mouth closed.
battle: Waiting at the line: the dead-leaf cloak pinned back from the shoulders, the left bracer on, the long bow held upright in the left hand with the string slack and NO arrow nocked, the quiver at the right hip holding his only arrow, feet planted a shoulder width apart as if nailed to the ground; a cold, fixed look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: both feet planted a shoulder width apart, the long bow held upright in the left hand, the right hand resting on the single arrow in the quiver, the back straight and the face level, a cold, fixed look and the mouth closed.
formal: Before the elven high court: a long silvery-green robe embroidered at the hems with small leaves, a pale mantle over one shoulder, a thin circlet of woven twigs, the long bow carried upright in the left hand. He stands tall and still, a calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the deep canopy-green eyes fixed on the viewer without blinking, as if waiting for the viewer to move first, the mouth closed. Cool forest light filtering through leaves from one side, a late golden gleam on the pale hair. Foreground blur: drifting leaves and the edge of the grip-worn bow limb. He wears the dead-leaf brown cloak.

name: 莉恩
src: 月银纪史诗/第九歌_落日之弓.md:229
who: Lien, a wood elf tree-climber of the great forest sea, who looks nineteen: about 162 cm, light and slight, long-fingered, the toes strong enough to grip bark. Short, tousled bright orange-red hair, a few living leaves tucked behind the tip of each pointed ear, which she picks herself and changes every three days. Bright leaf-green eyes like unfolding spring leaves, one small tiger-tooth showing when she grins. A small face with rosy cheeks and a few fine scratches across the bridge of the nose from tree bark. A lively, cheeky, mischievous air; she walks with a very slight care on the left foot, which nobody notices once she is in a tree. The living leaves are tucked behind BOTH ears: a small cluster of two or three green leaves behind the tip of the left ear and another cluster behind the tip of the right ear, visible on both sides of the head in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small, lively elf girl's face with bright leaf-green eyes, long pointed ears with living leaves tucked behind them, rosy cheeks, a few fine bark scratches across the nose, and a grin with one small tiger-tooth; she looks nineteen.
build: 162 cm, light and slim: slender arms and long fingers, a modest B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: orange-red and leaf green, bark brown, moss, a little bronze
casual: Her wood elf clothes: a short green tunic with close-fitted sleeves, bound tight at the cuffs, dark leggings, soft bark-soled shoes; woven vine bracers on both wrists, and at the belt a coil of thin cord with a small bronze bell tied to its end. A cheeky, grinning look. The tunic's sleeves are long and close-fitted all the way down to the wrist.
private: Lazing in the canopy village: a long-sleeved loose leaf-green linen tunic to mid-thigh over soft leggings, bare of the bracers, the short hair mussed, the leaves still behind the ears, a small piece of fruit held in one hand, a sleepy grin.
battle: Ready to scout and strike from the branches: a close-fitted leather jerkin over the green tunic, vine bracers, soft climbing shoes, a short hunting knife at the right hip and the coil of cord with the bronze bell hanging at the left hip. She holds the bell cord ready in her right hand, a keen, alert look.
battle_pose: 3) the scouting outfit: a light crouching ready stance on the balls of the feet, one hand holding the bell cord out to the side and the other flat as if testing the wind, the head up and the eyes bright and alert, the mouth closed; she is not a heavy fighter.
formal: At the elven court gathering: a long pale leaf-green sleeved dress with a vine-pattern band at the hem and cuffs, a belt of woven bark with a small bronze bell, fresh green leaves tucked behind the ears, the hair combed. She stands straight with the hands folded in front, trying hard to look serious.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the camera tilted, the bright leaf-green eyes looking sideways at the viewer with a cheeky half-grin showing the one small tiger-tooth. Dappled green sunlight from above on the orange-red hair. Foreground blur: drifting leaves and a thin bark branch. She wears the short green tunic with the vine bracers.

name: 朵拉
src: 月银纪史诗/第九歌_落日之弓.md:286
who: Dora, a human fur trader of the forest market on the edge of the old forest, nineteen: about 166 cm, sturdy, calloused hands, able to carry half a bundle of raw hides all day. Lilac hair tied high in one ponytail with a strip of fox tail fur. Cat-gold eyes that look once, then look a second time, and the second look is a valuation. A straight nose, a quick mouth; she smiles with one corner first. A burn scar on the back of her left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us), which she does not cover. A brisk, haggling, quick-witted air; her tongue is faster than an abacus.
build: 166 cm, sturdy and strong, calloused hands, a C-cup, a trim waist and firm hips.
palette: lilac and cat gold, leather brown, fox russet, a little bright silver
casual: Her trader's clothes: a plain coarse-woven blouse and a skirt over leggings, a polished, supple deer-hide waistcoat over them, sturdy laced boots; at the belt a coin purse and a small trader's balance, its arm a gift from an elf to her father, with silver-leaf pans; half a bundle of hides slung over her back with a strap. A sharp, appraising look.
private: Off the market stall: a long-sleeved, loose oatmeal linen shirt to mid-thigh over plain leggings and soft shoes, the lilac ponytail untied and falling down her back, the fox tail strip tied loosely round one wrist. She holds a small sweet pastry in one hand, a one-cornered grin.
battle: On the road with a heavy load: the deer-hide waistcoat buckled over a leather jerkin, leather gloves, a short skinning knife at the right hip, the small balance at the left hip, the bundle of hides strapped tight on her back. She holds the knife low in her right hand, a quick, calculating look.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: braced under the heavy bundle of hides on her back, the left hand on the strap and the right hand holding a short skinning knife low in front of her, the weight forward, a quick, calculating look and a one-cornered smirk; she is a trader, not a soldier.
formal: Signing a contract: a clean long dark-green wool dress with a high collar and long sleeves, a lilac ribbon in the ponytail, the polished silver-pan balance hung at the belt, the burn scar left uncovered on the back of the left hand. She stands straight with the chin raised, a polite, business-like smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the cat-gold eyes looking at the viewer with the second, valuing look, one corner of the mouth lifted. Warm afternoon forest light from one side on the lilac ponytail. Foreground blur: fur edges of drying hides and a small silver balance pan. She wears the deer-hide waistcoat.

name: 奥瑞尔
src: 月银纪史诗/第九歌_落日之弓.md:342
who: Aurel, an elf long-watcher of the elven court who looks about forty: about 185 cm, tall and spare, the back dead straight; when he stands still, forest beasts take him for a tree. Long silver-grey hair hanging to below the shoulders. A thin silver half-mask covers the left side of his face (on the viewer's right when they face us), and under it is sealed a single living leaf from the forest he guards, which has not withered in hundreds of years. The visible half of the face is lean and finely cut, the eye a deep still-pool blue that looks at things for a very long time. Hands like leaves that have been crumpled and smoothed again. A silent, patient, solemn air.
face: FACE, as in the references: the visible half of a lean, finely cut elf's face, one deep still-pool blue eye, long pointed ear, a thin closed mouth; a thin silver half-mask covers the left half of the face (on the viewer's right when they face us) with a green living leaf visible at its edge; he looks about forty.
build: 185 cm, tall and spare, a dead-straight back, long leaf-like hands.
palette: silver grey and deep pool blue, faded forest green, gold thread, old bow-wood brown
casual: His long-watcher's clothes: a long loose forest-coloured robe so old its colour cannot be named, torn places mended with gold thread so densely that the patches outnumber the cloth, a plain belt, soft boots. In his right hand an old long bow carved from a fallen tree of his own forest. A silent, patient look.
private: Off watch: the long robe loose and open at the collar, a plain pale linen shirt under it, the silver-grey hair loose, the half-mask still on, a quiet cup held in the right hand, a still, patient look.
battle: Keeping watch at the line: the patched forest robe pinned back, a dark leather bracer on the left arm, a quiver of arrows with pale silver-white heads at the hip on the right hand side, the long bow held upright in the left hand, the string slack. He stands completely still, a long, calm, attentive look.
battle_pose: 3) the watch outfit: standing completely still and upright like a tree, the long bow held upright in the left hand, the right hand resting on the quiver, the face level and the mouth closed.
formal: Before the elven court: a long grey-green court robe with a deep hem embroidered in silver leaves, the old gold-patched mantle left on one shoulder, the thin silver half-mask, the long bow carried upright in the left hand. He stands tall and still, a grave, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the single deep still-pool blue eye looking at the viewer for a very long time, the silver half-mask catching the light with the green leaf living under it, the mouth closed. Cool forest light filtering through leaves from one side. Foreground blur: drifting leaves and the grain of old bow wood. He wears the patched forest-coloured robe.
